item.title: [8] Theory of relaxation and its effects on the electronic structure in twisted systems
item.description:
Last authors: Bingbing Wang, Cheng-Cheng Liu

Authors: Junxi Yu, Bingbing Wang, Cheng-Cheng Liu

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Important theory for understanding moire bands in twisted systems.

Tags: #moire #twistedbilayer #electronicstructure

Abstract: Author(s): Junxi Yu, Bingbing Wang, and Cheng-Cheng Liu Here, the authors present an analytical and physically transparent theory of lattice relaxation in twisted systems. They show how the balance between intralayer elasticity and interlayer adhesion determines the relaxation pattern, and how this pattern can be analytically embedded into moiré electronic Hamiltonians. The work reveals how relaxation reshapes flat bands and shifts topological transitions toward experimentally relevant twist angles. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 245118] Published Mon Jun 08, 2026
